17-11-35.

Complaint made by Mrs. George, French Citizen.

At 3.30 p.m. on the 17-11-35, Mrs. George, French citizen, wife of Mr. Henri George — Secretary to the French Consular Court at Shanghai, residing with her husband in apartment 603 Embankment Building, came to this Station accompanied by Commandant Le Froc, residing at No. 7 Rue Chapsal.

Mrs. George reported that she suspected her house-boy of having administered some poison — or noxious substance into their food, thereby causing her husband to become sick.

C.D.S. 1:2 and the undersigned accompanied Mrs. George and Commandant Le Froc to Apartment 603 Embankment Building, where the house-boy — Yue Siam Ping (于小兵) was interviewed and later brought to Hongkew Station for enquiries.

Mrs. George — who does not speak English very clearly - made a very rambling statement in the presence of her husband and Commandant Le Froc which the undersigned had great difficulty in understanding owing to the disjointed and excitable manner in which the story was told, and the language difficulty.

The informant stated that, on the evening of the 14-11-35, her husband suddenly became very sick with abdominal pains shortly after having partaken of food cooked by herself and served at table by the above named house-boy,

1935年11月17日。

法国公民乔治夫人（Mrs. George）提出的投诉。

1935年11月17日下午3时30分，法国公民乔治夫人——上海法国领事法院秘书亨利·乔治（Henri George）先生的妻子，与其丈夫同住于外滩大厦603室——在居住于沙普萨尔路（Rue Chapsal）7号的勒弗罗克指挥官（Commandant Le Froc）陪同下，来到本巡捕房。

乔治夫人报告称，她怀疑其男仆在他们的食物中投放了某种毒药或有害物质，导致其丈夫生病。

刑事侦缉股警探1名及签署人陪同乔治夫人和勒弗罗克指挥官前往外滩大厦603室，对该男仆——于小兵（Yue Siam Ping）进行了问话，随后将其带至虹口巡捕房接受调查。

乔治夫人英语表达不太清晰，在其丈夫和勒弗罗克指挥官在场时做了一份非常散乱的陈述；由于其叙述方式支离破碎且情绪激动，加之语言障碍，签署人很难理解其内容。

报案人称，1935年11月14日晚，其丈夫在食用了由她自己烹饪、并由上述男仆端上餐桌的食物后不久，突然因腹痛而病重，
